sections.title: Value and Quality in Health Care
sections.description: Innovations in health care have the potential to achieve efficiency, reduce health care costs, and ensure high-quality patient outcomes. But to achieve these goals, we must determine and adopt standards for health care quality and safety. Through lectures, interviews with national leaders, case studies, and hands-on practice, this course introduces you to quality and measurement tools that make visible the most pressing areas of opportunity for health care innovation. You will explore how perceptions of value are specific to stakeholder needs. And you will learn how quality improvement initiatives can be leveraged to drive value for stakeholders across the health care system. In the final 2 weeks of the course, students will work together in groups to investigate and present a way to address a simulated challenge.
